## IFileHandlerFactory

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Provides easier access to all `IFileHandler` instances registered in a `Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Kernel`. Kernel-locked (one instance per chat). Also manages file attachments persistence.

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `HasFileHandlers` | `bool` | True if any file handlers are registered |

### Methods

#### CanHandleType(string contentType, string fileName)
Checks if any registered handler can process the given file type.

```csharp
bool CanHandleType(string contentType, string fileName);
```

#### GetKernelContent(string fileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Retrieves a file attachment by ID and converts it to `KernelContent`.

```csharp
Task<KernelContent> GetKernelContent(string fileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```

#### SaveAsync(Stream data, string contentType, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Saves stream data as a file attachment.

```csharp
Task<KernelContent?> SaveAsync(Stream data, string contentType, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```

#### SaveAsync(byte[] data, string contentType, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Saves byte array data as a file attachment.

```csharp
Task<KernelContent?> SaveAsync(byte[] data, string contentType, string name, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```

#### CancelAsync(KernelContent item, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Cancels a file attachment operation.

```csharp
Task CancelAsync(KernelContent item, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```

#### GetSupportedMimeTypes()
Returns the union of all MIME types supported by registered handlers.

```csharp
string[] GetSupportedMimeTypes();
```

#### GetExtension(string mimeType)
Returns the file extension for a given MIME type based on handler mappings.

```csharp
string? GetExtension(string mimeType);
```


Retrieves raw file data by attachment ID.





```csharp

```

### Implementation
`FileHandlerFactory` in `Cyrena.Runtime` — see `cyrena-runtime-filehandlerfactory` for the full implementation details and known issues (UpdateAsync saves `att` not `ext`, double-buffering in SaveAsync(Stream), typo "SUPPPORTED" in error strings).

### Usage
Used by chat components and connections to process file attachments without directly iterating handlers.

```csharp
if (fileHandlerFactory.CanHandleType("image/png", "screenshot.png"))
{
    var content = await fileHandlerFactory.SaveAsync(stream, "image/png", "screenshot.png");
}
```
